moral.zh: 睡眠不是让大脑关机；它帮助大脑整理和巩固记忆，也支持身体修复与生长、免疫协调和情绪调节。
moral.en: Sleep does not switch the brain off. It helps the brain organize and strengthen memories while supporting body repair and growth, immune coordination, and emotional regulation.

pages.zh: 晚上，小宝还在搭积木桥，妈妈却拉上窗帘：“到睡觉时间啦。”小宝不舍地问：“为什么每天都要睡觉？”
pages.en: At night, Xiaobao was still building a block bridge when Mama closed the curtains. "Time for bed." Xiaobao asked, "Why do we have to sleep every day?"

pages.en: After climbing into bed, Xiaobao asked, "Does the brain switch off like a lamp during sleep? If it does, where do dreams come from?"

pages.en: Mama said, "Sleep is not a shutdown. The brain stays active and moves through different sleep stages, organizing what you learned and helping important memories grow stronger."

pages.en: "During deep sleep, important signals that support growth become more active, and the body repairs tiny wear from the day's running and jumping."

pages.en: "Enough sleep also helps the immune system work in a coordinated way, so the body can respond better to germs it meets each day."

pages.en: "With enough sleep, it is easier to pay attention and manage feelings the next day. Too little sleep can make us distracted or irritable."
